name: Element-Wise Constraint Framing
description: Translates the global graph property of a triangle (or pairwise connectedness) into an element-wise requirement ("each process has a constraint with both of the other two"). This avoids common pattern-matching triggers like "triangle", "clique", or "every pair", forcing models to reconstruct the graph topology from local element rules, which often leads to naive O(N^3) implementations that Time Limit Exceed instead of the intended bitset optimization.
